value.rationale: The natural intrinsic lattice-encounter problem for uniform-matroid base polytopes is solved for every integral dilation, rank and dimension, including complete exact multiplicity probabilities. Fixed dilation reveals two sharp Gaussian rank-occupancy boundaries, and the doubled hypersimplex reveals a distinct center rank crossover from Gaussian entropy fluctuations to (noncentral) chi-square fluctuations. These are structurally motivated limits not merely single computed coefficients.
